clue_en: The audience keeps applauding after the planned final song. What may the performer return to play?
clue_et: Publik aplodeerib pärast kavas olnud viimast lugu edasi. Mida võib esineja naastes veel mängida?
explanation_en: An encore is an additional performance given after the scheduled programme has ended.
explanation_et: Lisalugu on pärast kavandatud programmi lõppu esitatav täiendav pala.

clue_en: What concert stunt carries a person above the audience on many raised hands?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse kontserditrikki, kus inimest kantakse publiku kohale tõstetud kätel?
explanation_en: During crowd surfing, audience members pass a person overhead from hand to hand.
explanation_et: Publiku kätel surfamisel annavad pealtvaatajad inimese pea kohal käest kätte edasi.

clue_en: What pre-show rehearsal lets musicians and technicians balance microphones and speakers?
clue_et: Milline kontserdieelne proov võimaldab muusikutel ja tehnikutel mikrofone ning kõlareid tasakaalustada?
explanation_en: A soundcheck tests the venue sound system and adjusts levels before the audience arrives.
explanation_et: Heliproovis katsetatakse saali helisüsteemi ja seadistatakse helitasemed enne publiku saabumist.

clue_en: What written order tells a band which songs it plans to play that night?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse kirja pandud järjekorda, mis näitab bändile, milliseid lugusid sel õhtul esitada?
explanation_en: A set list records the planned running order of songs for a performance.
explanation_et: Lugude nimekiri paneb paika kontserdil esitatavate palade kavandatud järjekorra.

clue_en: What performer appears before the main attraction to warm up the audience?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse esinejat, kes astub publiku soojendamiseks üles enne peaesinejat?
explanation_en: A supporting act performs an earlier, usually shorter set before the headliner.
explanation_et: Soojendusesineja annab enne peaesinejat tavaliselt lühema kontserdi.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which band recorded We Will Rock You, whose stomp-stomp-clap beat fills sports arenas?
clue_et: Milline bänd salvestas spordiareenidel kõlava tramp-tramp-plaks-rütmiga loo „We Will Rock You“?
explanation_en: Queen released We Will Rock You on the 1977 album News of the World.
explanation_et: Queen avaldas loo „We Will Rock You“ 1977. aasta albumil „News of the World“.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Whose recording of Sweet Caroline invites crowds to sing its famous “ba, ba, ba” response?
clue_et: Kelle salvestatud „Sweet Caroline“ kutsub publikut kaasa laulma kuulsat „ba, ba, ba“ vastust?
explanation_en: Neil Diamond wrote and recorded Sweet Caroline, which became a crowd singalong at many sporting events.
explanation_et: Neil Diamond kirjutas ja salvestas loo „Sweet Caroline“, millest sai paljudel spordiüritustel ühislaul.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Supporters of which English football club are especially famous for singing You’ll Never Walk Alone?
clue_et: Millise Inglise jalgpalliklubi poolehoidjad on eriti tuntud laulu „You’ll Never Walk Alone“ laulmise poolest?
explanation_en: Liverpool supporters adopted You’ll Never Walk Alone in the 1960s and still sing it before matches.
explanation_et: Liverpooli poolehoidjad võtsid laulu „You’ll Never Walk Alone“ omaks 1960. aastatel ja laulavad seda enne mänge siiani.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which rock duo created the seven-note riff that crowds chant from Seven Nation Army?
clue_et: Milline rokkduo lõi loo „Seven Nation Army“ seitsmenoodilise rifi, mida publik skandeerib?
explanation_en: The White Stripes released Seven Nation Army in 2003, and its riff became a worldwide sports chant.
explanation_et: The White Stripes avaldas „Seven Nation Army“ 2003. aastal ning selle rifist sai üleilmne spordiskandeering.

category_name_en: Music: Songs Heard Around the Stadium
clue_en: Which Italian singer recorded Freed from Desire, later adapted into the football chant “Will Grigg’s on Fire”?
clue_et: Milline Itaalia lauljanna salvestas loo „Freed from Desire“, millest tehti hiljem jalgpalliskandeering „Will Grigg’s on Fire“?
explanation_en: Gala Rizzatto released Freed from Desire in 1996, and its melody later became a popular football chant.
explanation_et: Gala Rizzatto avaldas „Freed from Desire“ 1996. aastal ning selle meloodiast sai hiljem populaarne jalgpalliskandeering.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Four Beatles walk across a zebra crossing on the cover of which album?
clue_et: Millise albumi kaanel kõnnivad neli biitlit üle sebra?
explanation_en: The Beatles were photographed on the crossing outside their London studio for the Abbey Road cover.
explanation_et: The Beatles pildistati „Abbey Roadi“ kaane jaoks Londonis stuudio ees oleval sebral.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which band put a swimming baby chasing a dollar bill on the cover of Nevermind?
clue_et: Milline bänd pani albumi „Nevermind“ kaanele dollarit taga ajava ujuva beebi?
explanation_en: Nirvana used the underwater baby photograph for the cover of its 1991 album Nevermind.
explanation_et: Nirvana kasutas veealuse beebi fotot oma 1991. aasta albumi „Nevermind“ kaanel.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which musician appears with a red-and-blue lightning bolt across his face on the cover of Aladdin Sane?
clue_et: Milline muusik on albumi „Aladdin Sane“ kaanel, näol punasinine välgunool?
explanation_en: Brian Duffy photographed David Bowie in the lightning-bolt makeup created for the Aladdin Sane cover.
explanation_et: Brian Duffy pildistas David Bowiet „Aladdin Sane’i“ kaane jaoks loodud välgunoolemeigiga.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which pop artist designed the peelable banana cover for The Velvet Underground & Nico?
clue_et: Milline popkunstnik kujundas albumile „The Velvet Underground & Nico“ kooritava banaaniga kaane?
explanation_en: Andy Warhol supplied the banana artwork and was credited as the album producer.
explanation_et: Andy Warhol lõi banaanikujunduse ja oli albumil märgitud produtsendina.

category_name_en: Music: Album Covers in the Cultural Memory
clue_en: Which Joy Division album has a black cover crossed by stacked white radio-wave lines from a pulsar?
clue_et: Millise Joy Divisioni albumi mustal kaanel on pulsari raadiosignaalist pärit üksteise kohal valged jooned?
explanation_en: The Unknown Pleasures cover visualises radio pulses recorded from pulsar CP 1919.
explanation_et: „Unknown Pleasuresi“ kaanel on kujutatud pulsari CP 1919 salvestatud raadioimpulsse.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which curved metal wind instrument with a single-reed mouthpiece is strongly associated with jazz?
clue_et: Milline kõver metallist puhkpill kasutab ühte lesthuulikut ja seostub eriti džässiga?
explanation_en: The saxophone has a conical metal body but produces sound with a single reed like a clarinet.
explanation_et: Saksofonil on kooniline metallkorpus, kuid heli tekitab klarneti moodi üksik lest.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which instrument has an air bag under the player’s arm and several pipes rising from it?
clue_et: Millisel pillil on mängija kaenla all õhukott, millest ulatub välja mitu toru?
explanation_en: Bagpipes feed stored air from a bag into a melody pipe and one or more drone pipes.
explanation_et: Torupill juhib kotis oleva õhu viisitorusse ja ühte või mitmesse burdoonitorusse.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which small tube-shaped instrument changes a player’s humming into a buzzing sound?
clue_et: Milline väike torukujuline pill muudab mängija ümisemise põrisevaks heliks?
explanation_en: A kazoo uses a vibrating membrane to colour the sound of a player humming into it.
explanation_et: Kazuu membraan võngub, kui mängija pilli sisse ümiseb, ning muudab heli kõla.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which tuned metal instrument from Trinidad and Tobago is made from a concave steel surface?
clue_et: Milline Trinidadist ja Tobagost pärit häälestatud metallpill on valmistatud nõgusast teraspinnast?
explanation_en: A steelpan has tuned note areas hammered into the surface of a steel drum.
explanation_et: Steelpannil on terastrumli pinnale vormitud häälestatud noodialad.

category_name_en: Music: Instruments with an Unmistakable Look
clue_en: Which electronic instrument is played without touch by moving both hands near two antennas?
clue_et: Millist elektroonilist pilli mängitakse puudutamata, liigutades käsi kahe antenni lähedal?
explanation_en: A theremin senses hand position around its antennas to control pitch and volume.
explanation_et: Teremin tajub käte asendit antennide ümber ning juhib selle järgi helikõrgust ja tugevust.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which offbeat popular-music style grew in Jamaica and was taken worldwide by artists such as Bob Marley?
clue_et: Milline rõhutatud vasturütmiga levimuusikastiil kasvas välja Jamaical ja levis maailma muu hulgas Bob Marley kaudu?
explanation_en: Reggae developed in Jamaica in the late 1960s from ska, rocksteady, and other influences.
explanation_et: Reggae kujunes Jamaical 1960. aastate lõpus ska, rocksteady ja teiste mõjutuste põhjal.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which partner dance grew around the Río de la Plata in Argentina and Uruguay?
clue_et: Milline paaristants kasvas välja Argentina ja Uruguay vahelise Río de la Plata ümbruses?
explanation_en: Tango emerged in working-class districts around Buenos Aires and Montevideo.
explanation_et: Tango tekkis Buenos Airese ja Montevideo töölislinnaosades.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: What Mexican ensemble tradition features violins, trumpets, and guitar-family instruments in matching dress?
clue_et: Milline Mehhiko ansamblitraditsioon ühendab viiulid, trompetid ja kitarrilaadsed pillid ning ühtse riietuse?
explanation_en: Modern mariachi groups combine strings and trumpets and are strongly associated with Mexican celebrations.
explanation_et: Tänapäeva mariachi-ansamblid ühendavad keelpille ja trompeteid ning kuuluvad tihedalt Mehhiko pidustuste juurde.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which Portuguese song tradition is known for expressive singing about longing and fate?
clue_et: Milline Portugali laulutraditsioon on tuntud igatsusest ja saatusest rääkiva tundelise esituse poolest?
explanation_en: Fado became established in Lisbon and is commonly accompanied by Portuguese guitar.
explanation_et: Fado kinnistus Lissabonis ning seda saadab tavaliselt Portugali kitarr.

category_name_en: Music: Sounds with a Place of Origin
clue_en: Which witty, topical song style developed in Trinidad and Tobago and spread internationally in the twentieth century?
clue_et: Milline teravmeelne ja päevakajaline laulustiil kujunes Trinidadis ja Tobagos ning levis kahekümnendal sajandil maailma?
explanation_en: Calypso singers use memorable melodies and wordplay to comment on public events and society.
explanation_et: Kalüpsolauljad kommenteerivad meeldejäävate meloodiate ja sõnamänguga ühiskonda ning päevasündmusi.

clue_en: Before her solo career, Beyoncé sang in which group with hits such as Say My Name?
clue_et: Millises hittidega „Say My Name“ tuntud ansamblis laulis Beyoncé enne soolokarjääri?
explanation_en: Beyoncé rose to fame as a member of Destiny’s Child before releasing solo albums.
explanation_et: Beyoncé sai tuntuks Destiny’s Childi liikmena enne sooloalbumite avaldamist.

clue_en: Which Genesis drummer later became the band’s lead singer and a major solo star?
clue_et: Millisest Genesise trummarist sai hiljem bändi laulja ja suur sooloartist?
explanation_en: Phil Collins joined Genesis as drummer and took over lead vocals after Peter Gabriel left.
explanation_et: Phil Collins liitus Genesisega trummarina ja võttis pärast Peter Gabrieli lahkumist üle laulja rolli.

clue_en: Stefani Germanotta records pop music under which name?
clue_et: Millise nime all salvestab Stefani Germanotta popmuusikat?
explanation_en: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta adopted Lady Gaga as her professional name.
explanation_et: Stefani Joanne Angelina Germanotta võttis artistinimeks Lady Gaga.

clue_en: Farrokh Bulsara became the lead singer of Queen under which name?
clue_et: Millise nime all sai Farrokh Bulsarast Queeni laulja?
explanation_en: Farrokh Bulsara adopted the name Freddie Mercury while building his career with Queen.
explanation_et: Farrokh Bulsara võttis Queeniga karjääri alustades nimeks Freddie Mercury.

clue_en: Reginald Kenneth Dwight became famous under which stage name?
clue_et: Millise lavanime all sai kuulsaks Reginald Kenneth Dwight?
explanation_en: The British singer and pianist legally changed his name to Elton Hercules John.
explanation_et: Briti laulja ja pianist muutis oma nime ametlikult Elton Hercules Johniks.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which composer wrote the piano favourite Für Elise?
clue_et: Milline helilooja kirjutas populaarse klaveripala „Für Elise“?
explanation_en: Beethoven’s Bagatelle No. 25 in A minor is widely known by its dedication Für Elise.
explanation_et: Beethoveni bagatelli nr 25 a-mollis tuntakse laialt pühenduse „Für Elise“ järgi.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: The Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy comes from which Tchaikovsky ballet?
clue_et: Millisest Tšaikovski balletist pärineb Suhkruhaldja tants?
explanation_en: Tchaikovsky included the Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy in the second act of The Nutcracker.
explanation_et: Tšaikovski lisas Suhkruhaldja tantsu „Pähklipureja“ teise vaatusse.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Who composed the Bridal Chorus commonly heard as “Here Comes the Bride”?
clue_et: Kes kirjutas pulmatseremooniatelt tuntud pruudikoori „Here Comes the Bride“?
explanation_en: Wagner wrote the Bridal Chorus for his opera Lohengrin.
explanation_et: Wagner kirjutas pruudikoori ooperile „Lohengrin“.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which Richard Strauss tone poem accompanies the famous sunrise in Stanley Kubrick’s space epic?
clue_et: Milline Richard Straussi sümfooniline poeem saadab Stanley Kubricku kosmoseeepose kuulsat päikesetõusu?
explanation_en: Stanley Kubrick used the opening fanfare of Also sprach Zarathustra in 2001: A Space Odyssey.
explanation_et: Stanley Kubrick kasutas filmi „2001: Kosmoseodüsseia“ alguses teose „Nõnda kõneles Zarathustra“ fanfaari.

category_name_en: Music: Classical Tunes Beyond the Concert Hall
clue_en: Which composer wrote O Fortuna as the opening and closing movement of Carmina Burana?
clue_et: Milline helilooja kirjutas „O Fortuna“ kantaadi „Carmina Burana“ ava- ja lõpupalaks?
explanation_en: Carl Orff set the medieval poem O Fortuna to music in his cantata Carmina Burana.
explanation_et: Carl Orff viis keskaegse luuletuse „O Fortuna“ muusikasse kantaadis „Carmina Burana“.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which battle gave its name to the song that won Eurovision for ABBA?
clue_et: Milline lahing andis nime laulule, millega ABBA Eurovisiooni võitis?
explanation_en: ABBA’s song compares a romantic surrender with Napoleon’s defeat at Waterloo.
explanation_et: ABBA laul võrdleb romantilist alistumist Napoleoni kaotusega Waterloo lahingus.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which comedy film sent its characters headbanging in a car to Queen’s Bohemian Rhapsody?
clue_et: Millises komöödiafilmis kuulavad tegelased autos Queeni „Bohemian Rhapsodyt“ ja loobivad pead?
explanation_en: The car singalong in Wayne’s World helped return Bohemian Rhapsody to the charts.
explanation_et: Filmi „Wayne’i maailm“ autostseen aitas „Bohemian Rhapsody“ uuesti edetabelitesse.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which band turned a casino fire beside Lake Geneva into the song Smoke on the Water?
clue_et: Milline bänd tegi Genfi järve ääres puhkenud kasiinopõlengust laulu „Smoke on the Water“?
explanation_en: Deep Purple wrote Smoke on the Water after seeing smoke spread over Lake Geneva from the Montreux Casino fire.
explanation_et: Deep Purple kirjutas „Smoke on the Wateri“ pärast seda, kui Montreux’ kasiino põlengu suits levis üle Genfi järve.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: Which science-fiction film inspired the title of David Bowie’s song Space Oddity?
clue_et: Milline ulmefilm inspireeris David Bowie laulu „Space Oddity“ pealkirja?
explanation_en: Bowie’s title was a play on 2001: A Space Odyssey, which he saw before writing the song.
explanation_et: Bowie pealkiri mängis filmi „2001: Kosmoseodüsseia“ nimega; ta nägi filmi enne laulu kirjutamist.

category_name_en: Music: Hits with a Hidden Connection
clue_en: The Nokia tune borrows a phrase from Gran Vals by which Spanish classical guitarist?
clue_et: Nokia helin laenab fraasi millise Hispaania klassikalise kitarristi teosest „Gran Vals“?
explanation_en: The familiar Nokia tune comes from a phrase in Tárrega’s 1902 guitar piece Gran Vals.
explanation_et: Tuntud Nokia helin pärineb Tárrega 1902. aasta kitarripala „Gran Vals“ fraasist.

clue_en: What kind of notation symbol marks a measured period of silence?
clue_et: Milline noodikirja märk tähistab kindla pikkusega vaikust?
explanation_en: Each rest symbol represents silence lasting for a defined note value.
explanation_et: Iga pausimärk tähistab kindla noodivältuse pikkust vaikust.

clue_en: Which clef, also called the G clef, is normally used for higher-pitched notes?
clue_et: Millist võtit, mida nimetatakse ka G-võtmeks, kasutatakse tavaliselt kõrgemate nootide jaoks?
explanation_en: The treble clef curls around the staff line assigned to the note G.
explanation_et: Viiulivõti keerdub ümber noodijoone, millel asub noot G.

clue_en: Which musical symbol tells a player to raise a note by one semitone?
clue_et: Milline muusikamärk käsib mängijal tõsta nooti ühe pooltooni võrra?
explanation_en: A sharp raises the pitch of its note by one semitone in standard notation.
explanation_et: Diees tõstab noodiga märgitud heli kõrgust ühe pooltooni võrra.

clue_en: Which clef is commonly used for low instruments such as the bass guitar and cello?
clue_et: Millist võtit kasutatakse sageli madalate pillide, näiteks basskitarri ja tšello nootide kirjutamiseks?
explanation_en: The bass clef, or F clef, places its dots around the line for the note F.
explanation_et: Bassivõtme ehk F-võtme kaks punkti ümbritsevad noodijoont, millel asub noot F.

clue_en: Which notation sign cancels an earlier sharp or flat and restores the unaltered pitch?
clue_et: Milline noodimärk tühistab varasema dieesi või bemolli ja taastab muutmata helikõrguse?
explanation_en: A natural sign cancels a sharp or flat that would otherwise alter the note.
explanation_et: Bekarr tühistab dieesi või bemolli, mis muidu noodi helikõrgust muudaks.

clue_en: Which standard female singing range lies above mezzo-soprano?
clue_et: Milline tavapärane naise lauluhääl paikneb metsosopranist kõrgemal?
explanation_en: No standard female category in classical part writing is placed above soprano.
explanation_et: Klassikalises häälestuses ei paigutata ühtki tavapärast naishäält sopranist kõrgemale.

clue_en: Which lower female voice often sings beneath the sopranos in a choir?
clue_et: Milline madalam naishääl laulab kooris sageli sopranitest allpool?
explanation_en: Alto is the lower female part in the usual four-part choral arrangement.
explanation_et: Alt on tavapärases neljahäälses kooriseades madalam naishääl.

clue_en: An adult male part above baritone normally uses which vocal range?
clue_et: Millist hääleliiki kasutab täiskasvanud meeslaulja baritonist kõrgemas partiis?
explanation_en: No common adult male category in classical part writing is placed above tenor.
explanation_et: Klassikalises häälestuses ei paigutata ühtki levinud täiskasvanud mehe häält tenorist kõrgemale.

clue_en: The lowest standard male choral part has what name?
clue_et: Kuidas nimetatakse koori madalaimat tavapärast meeshäält?
explanation_en: Bass is the lowest standard male vocal range and anchors four-part harmony.
explanation_et: Bass on madalaim tavapärane meeshääl ning annab neljahäälsele harmooniale aluse.

clue_en: Which male singing voice lies between tenor and bass?
clue_et: Milline meeshääl asub tenori ja bassi vahel?
explanation_en: Baritone occupies the middle male range between the higher tenor and lower bass.
explanation_et: Bariton paikneb kõrgema tenori ja madalama bassi vahel.

clue_en: Who stands before an orchestra and coordinates its tempo, entries, and interpretation?
clue_et: Kes seisab orkestri ees ning juhib tempot, pillirühmade sisseastumisi ja teose tõlgendust?
explanation_en: A conductor leads the ensemble through visible gestures and rehearsal decisions.
explanation_et: Dirigent juhib ansamblit nähtavate žestide ja proovides tehtud tõlgendusotsustega.

clue_en: Which orchestra section includes violins, violas, cellos, and double basses?
clue_et: Millisesse orkestrirühma kuuluvad viiulid, vioolad, tšellod ja kontrabassid?
explanation_en: Bowed string instruments form a principal section of the modern orchestra.
explanation_et: Poognaga mängitavad keelpillid moodustavad ühe nüüdisaegse orkestri põhirühma.

clue_en: Which orchestra section contains instruments mainly struck, shaken, or scraped?
clue_et: Milline orkestrirühm sisaldab peamiselt löödavaid, raputatavaid või kraabitavaid pille?
explanation_en: The percussion section includes drums, cymbals, and many other struck instruments.
explanation_et: Löökpillide hulka kuuluvad trummid, taldrikud ja paljud muud löödavad pillid.

clue_en: Which orchestra section includes trumpets, horns, trombones, and tubas?
clue_et: Millisesse orkestrirühma kuuluvad trompetid, metsasarved, tromboonid ja tuubad?
explanation_en: Players in the brass section produce sound by buzzing their lips into a mouthpiece.
explanation_et: Vaskpuhkpillimängijad tekitavad heli huulikusse surutud huulte võnkumisega.

clue_en: Which principal violinist leads the orchestra’s string section and usually sits nearest the conductor?
clue_et: Milline esiviiuldaja juhib orkestri keelpillirühma ja istub tavaliselt dirigendile kõige lähemal?
explanation_en: The concertmaster is the lead violinist and senior player in a standard orchestra.
explanation_et: Kontsertmeister on tavapärase orkestri juhtiv viiuldaja ja vanemmängija.

clue_en: Which pair of handheld rattles is shaken to add a crisp rhythm in much Latin American music?
clue_et: Millist käes hoitavat kõristipilli paari raputatakse paljudes Ladina-Ameerika muusikastiilides terava rütmi loomiseks?
explanation_en: Seeds or beads inside the hollow shells strike their walls when the player shakes them.
explanation_et: Õõnsate kestade sees olevad seemned või helmed löövad raputamisel vastu seinu.

clue_en: Which percussion instrument has tuned wooden bars arranged like a keyboard?
clue_et: Millisel löökpillil on klaviatuuri moodi paigutatud häälestatud puitplaadid?
explanation_en: A xylophone produces notes when its graduated wooden bars are struck with mallets.
explanation_et: Ksülofonil tekivad noodid, kui eri pikkusega puitplaate lüüakse nuiadega.

clue_en: Which percussion instruments are thin metal discs that may be struck together or with sticks?
clue_et: Millised löökpillid on õhukesed metallkettad, mida lüüakse kokku või pulkadega?
explanation_en: Cymbals create bright crashing or shimmering sounds from vibrating metal discs.
explanation_et: Taldrikud tekitavad vibreerivate metallketastega eredaid kõlavaid või sillerdavaid helisid.

clue_en: Which percussion instrument is a metal bar bent into a three-sided shape?
clue_et: Milline löökpill on kolmnurkseks painutatud metallvarras?
explanation_en: The open-cornered metal triangle rings when struck with a metal beater.
explanation_et: Avatud nurgaga metalltriangel heliseb, kui seda lüüa metallpulgaga.

clue_en: Which orchestral kettle drums can be tuned to specific pitches, often with a pedal?
clue_et: Milliseid orkestri kateltrumme saab häälestada kindlatele helikõrgustele, sageli pedaaliga?
explanation_en: Timpani use a stretched head over a bowl and a mechanism that changes its tension.
